# Unify

> Unify is a B2B outbound platform that combines 25+ intent signals with AI agents and automated multi-channel sequences to help companies identify, qualify, and engage buyers automatically. Founded in 2023, backed by $52M+ from OpenAI Startup Fund, Thrive Capital, Battery Ventures, and Emergence Capital. Used by Perplexity, Cursor, Together AI, Justworks, and hundreds of fast-growing companies.

## Product

- [Product Tour](https://www.unifygtm.com/product-tour): Interactive walkthrough of the Unify platform
- [Signals](https://www.unifygtm.com/signals): 25+ B2B intent signals including website visits, product usage, champion tracking, hiring activity, and AI-powered Infinity Signals
- [AI Agents](https://www.unifygtm.com/ai): AI-powered lead research, qualification, and message personalization agents
- [Plays](https://www.unifygtm.com/plays): Workflow builder for automated prospecting, enrichment, and sequence enrollment
- [Engagement](https://www.unifygtm.com/product/sales-engagment): Multi-channel outbound execution with managed mailboxes and deliverability
- [B2B Contact Data](https://www.unifygtm.com/product/buyer-data): Aggregated contact data from multiple providers (Clearbit, 6sense, Demandbase, Snitcher)
- [Analytics](https://www.unifygtm.com/analytics): Pipeline attribution and outbound performance reporting

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.unifygtm.com/pricing): Growth plan starts at $1,000/month (monthly) or $1,740/month (annual). Pro and Enterprise plans with custom pricing. Credit-based system for data and actions.

## Customer Results

- [Customer Stories](https://www.unifygtm.com/customers): Case studies with verified ROI metrics
- [Justworks](https://www.unifygtm.com/customers/justworks): 6.8X ROI in 5 months
- [Spellbook](https://www.unifygtm.com/customers/spellbook): $2.59M pipeline and $250K revenue in 7 months
- [Perplexity](https://www.unifygtm.com/customers/perplexity): $1.7M pipeline growth in 3 months with zero BDRs
- [Campfire](https://www.unifygtm.com/customers/campfire): Doubled qualified outbound pipeline in 5 months
- [Anrok](https://www.unifygtm.com/customers/anrok): $300K pipeline in 3 months
- [Hypercomply](https://www.unifygtm.com/customers/hypercomply): Eliminated 100 hours of manual work per month
